newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Thakral Corp ties up US$250 mln credit.
newsitem.headline: Thakral Corp ties up US$250 mln credit.

text.p: Thakral Corp Ltd said on Monday it had entered into a US$250 million revolving credit facility with 17 Singapore-based banks with HongKong and Shanghai Banking Corp Ltd acting as facility agent.
It said in a statement the purpose was to repay Thakral Corp (HK) Ltd's outstanding trade credit facilities and to finance its ongoing trade requirements.
The facility will be secured by the corporate guarantees of Thakral Corp (HK) and Thakral Overseas Pte Ltd.

The bank syndication will also facilitate the setting up of a regional finance and treasury centre in Singapore by Thakral Corp, being one of the requirements of converting its share quotation from a US dollar listing to a Singapore dollar listing.
